entities.summary: Yitzhak Epstein, also known as Yitzhak and Isaac Epstein was a Russian-born Jewish linguist and educator in Palestine. He is most remembered for his text “The Hidden Question,” which focused on relations between Zionists and Arab Palestinians. He pioneered the “natural method” of teaching Hebrew, in which the teacher makes explanations only in Hebrew.
